title.value: IGLUE: A Benchmark for Transfer Learning across Modalities, Tasks, and Languages
title.justification: The paper introduces the Image-Grounded Language Understanding Evaluation benchmark, as indicated in both the title and throughout the abstract, focusing on various modalities, tasks, and languages.
title.quote: we introduce the Image-Grounded Language Understanding Evaluation benchmark.

extractions.description: This paper presents the IGLUE benchmark for evaluating multilingual multimodal models. It focuses on tasks like visual question answering, cross-modal retrieval, grounded reasoning, and entails reasoning across 20 languages. The benchmark assesses models on zero-shot and few-shot learning setups, aiming to reduce performance gaps in multilingual contexts. The benchmark compiles existing datasets and introduces new ones to cover a wide range of vision-and-language challenges, promoting inclusivity and diversity in language processing.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The central theme of the paper is the evaluation of multilingual multimodal models through the IGLUE benchmark. While it discusses language diversity and inclusivity, it does not focus on Climate or Ecologically-Related Sustainable Development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Due to the lack of a multilingual benchmark, however, vision-and-language research has mostly focused on English language tasks. To fill this gap, we introduce the Image-Grounded Language Understanding Evaluation benchmark.

primary_category.justification: The paper primarily focuses on natural language processing and machine learning benchmarks rather than Climate or Ecologically-Related Sustainable Development, making it irrelevant to sustainability categories.
primary_category.quote: Reliable evaluation benchmarks designed for replicability and comprehensiveness have driven progress in machine learning.

primary_sub_category.justification: No elements of the paper align with Climate or Ecologically-Related Sustainable Development sub-categories; it solely presents a multilingual benchmark for vision-and-language tasks.
primary_sub_category.quote: Our benchmark enables the evaluation of multilingual multimodal models for transfer learning.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper does not fit into any new or existing Climate or Ecologically-Related Sustainable Development category as it focuses on NLP and machine learning.
new_primary_category.quote: Nonetheless, this trend is reversing by virtue of a series of independent efforts in the the V&L research community.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: There are no appropriate new or existing sub-categories applicable to this paper since it is focused on machine learning and NLP benchmarks for multilingual contexts.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: These benchmarks have been proven invaluable as key drivers of recent steep performance progress of NLP.
